source: BB #2474 plus committed Track-C case packets

cases.surface: A task row was set to done while T5-T7 existed only as untracked files in a detached worktree and no durable ref reached them.

roles.durable_ref_code: working code durably reachable from a git ref

cases.surface: The frame-expansion detector treated plural or substring matches as concept coverage and fired nearly everywhere, so its green signal did not discriminate real gaps.

roles.coverage_claim: concept is covered or a genuine gap was detected

cases.surface: jobs.json reported last_run null while the cron job was executing and still reported null after completion; the event log showed the run.
252 tests passed and were cited for a change, but none invoked the changed runtime path.
An empty grep for one target was generalized into a universal claim that no targets existed.

roles.population_wide_absence: absence across the complete search space

cases.surface: An embedding fix was merged, but the required backend was absent so the code silently used a fallback and the fix never executed.

roles.live_embedding_invocation: embedding backend executes on live inputs

cases.surface: PgDimensionLibrary was merged, but no runtime constructed it and its table existed in no database.

roles.runtime_db_instance: runtime instance reads an applied table
roles.construction_and_catalog_trace: constructor trace plus database catalog query

cases.surface: A subscription-mode config edit existed in a working tree, then a merge restored metered billing because the intended config was not durable on the ref.

roles.ref_and_runtime_readback: post-merge ref readback and runtime mode

cases.surface: A tool advertised --timeout 600, but a hung subprocess continued because the flag never reached an enforcing kill path.

roles.deadline_enforced_claim: hung work is terminated within 600 seconds
roles.hung_child_liveness_trace: deliberately hung child and process-liveness trace

cases.surface: `git ls-remote origin <branch> | head -1 && echo ON` exited 0 and printed ON for a branch that did not exist because head returned 0 on empty input and the pipe swallowed ls-remote's status. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable replacement check.

A DB_QUERY_MATCHES predicate passed whenever a query returned at least one row, so `SELECT 1` was accepted as proof that an unrelated invariant held. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable replacement predicate.

roles.nonempty_row_count: query returned at least one row

cases.surface: A verifier wrote predicate-execution records only on clean-green agreement. FAIL or UNKNOWN wrote nothing, so no record could mean never ran or ran and disagreed. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable recording/check protocol.

roles.actual_execution_outcome: never ran vs pass vs fail vs unknown

cases.surface: An adequacy oracle parsed zero clauses and returned CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS even though the task had a clear four-bullet definition_of_done. The parser read the wrong location and received an empty object/list. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable check that distinguishes ambiguous content from failed extraction.

`find /Users/kevincthomas -name X` returned empty and was treated as proof work never existed, but the files were under /private/tmp outside the search tree and had been moved on the searcher's own instruction. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable search.

roles.empty_home_search: find under one root returned nothing

rules.text: A check used as evidence must be capable of returning the true negative when the claimed effect is absent or violated.
rules.rationale: Every case failed because the accepted check could not express or reach the relevant negative for the claimed effect.

rules.text: Validate the claimed effect through an effect-bound observation rather than treating a producer receipt or proxy as the effect itself.
rules.rationale: All 14 substitute a proxy/receipt for direct observation of the thing claimed.

rules.text: Evaluate a classifier, matcher, parser, or search query on labelled positive and deliberately violating negative input fixtures.
rules.rationale: These seven are classifier/matcher/parser/query discrimination failures with constructible positive and negative inputs; the remaining cases concern durability, runtime activation, persistence, or configuration effects.

rules.text: Trace runtime construction, selected backend, or deployed configuration before claiming that committed implementation is active.
rules.rationale: These four specifically concern code/config/guards present on the surface but absent or different in the executing path.

rules.text: Enumerate every authorized search scope before converting an empty scoped query into a universal absence claim.
rules.rationale: These two search only a subset of possible locations then universalize the empty result; R1 targets the intended remote but masks no-match status.

rules.text: Re-run the relevant test against a deliberately broken or disabled implementation and require it to fail.
rules.rationale: These five have an implementation/backend/construction/guard whose disabling or mutation should make the cited check go red.

rules.text: Persist an execution record for PASS, FAIL, and UNKNOWN rather than recording only agreement.
rules.rationale: R3 alone records only clean-green agreement and cannot represent ran-and-disagreed.

rules.text: Resolve the exact durable git ref—and the remote ref when remote existence is claimed—before declaring code complete or a branch present.
rules.rationale: A1 requires a durable ref for completion; R1 requires the exact remote ref for branch existence.

rules.text: Never trust a null last-run timestamp as evidence that a scheduler job did not execute.
rules.rationale: This is specific to the vestigial scheduler timestamp.

rules.text: Express a database invariant as zero violating rows, for example with HAVING COUNT(*)=0, rather than accepting any nonempty result.
rules.rationale: This is the SQL row-count defect only.

rules.text: For shell remote-existence checks, require no-match to be nonzero (`--exit-code` or explicit nonempty output) and preserve that status through the pipeline.
rules.rationale: R1 alone masks the remote no-match; pipefail by itself is insufficient because ls-remote normally returns zero on no match.

rules.text: Report extraction-location/status failures separately from ambiguity in the extracted input.
rules.rationale: This is the contract-parser wrong-location defect only.

corrections_applied: B1 rewritten narrowly to classifier/matcher/parser/search fixtures and set to A2,A5,A6,R1,R2,R4,R5
D2 text changed to durable ref so A1 and R1 remain
D5 fixed to require --exit-code/nonempty output, not pipefail alone
